review: Reviewed Sol's round-62 request (make and test vine cordage) and the accepted world-97 develop review (learning 4): a general make-and-test-cordage operation with prepare, form, test, inspect, resume, cancel and recover-material, which must not output a cord or strength until an auditable material-behavior and hand-manipulation contract determines strand continuity, workable length, flexibility, joining and response to tension. Otherwise it allows only the smallest real precursor, with unsupported measurements labeled unsupported rather than given numbers. Inspection found that vine records carry only mass, hardness, flexibility and moisture, with no continuity, length, joining or tension representation; the ex13 piece model belongs to another run and its documentation already states that calibrated force and load capacity are unsupported. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical rules, so implemented make-and-test-cordage@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general first release, following weather-barrier@1 and air-dry-food@1. Prepare performs real checks of the named owned sample (ownership, reservation, 0.1-unit quantity, available balance) and fails with the exact report, labeling every requested measurement unsupported. Recorded deviation from the review: the precursor's 0.5-energy preparation charge is not applied, because without a bending or separation model the attempt has no observable result and charging would only spend the actor's energy; nothing is reserved, changed or spent. Form, test, inspect, resume, cancel and recover-material fail at no cost because no prepared sample, cord or test can exist. No reward is added. Blocker recorded for the human: a material-behavior and tension model must be decided separately. This is the eighth and last development handoff of this run's budget. Tests cover the sample report for an actually gathered vine, the uneven-quantity report, unchanged stacks and energy, and failure of every other mode.
